cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Yes, Under My Physics
cards.instruction: Agree completely, then redefine each term using rules that make your preferred outcome inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely, I'll move forward for the photo. Forward means facing the camera; I'm staying here in the shade.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need you two feet closer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll lean towards you; a foot means a notch of zoom. Give it two.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Full means all the important parts. Take the picture; I'll keep still.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 agrees then defines forward to preserve shade; A3 gives a real lean while redefining feet as zoom and A5 accepts the resulting crop as full under a new definition.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 two feet causes A3 two zoom notches; B4 face-only result causes A5 important-parts definition and shutter request.

relationship.evidence: B2 seeks physical framing and B4 reports the crop, rather than asking about A philosophy.

heightening.evidence: A5 the failed intended framing becomes success by another rule while A remains in preferred shade.

specificity.evidence: A1 photo and shade state task and preferred outcome; A3 lean is compatible with staying in shade.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 definition is addressed to the photographer to authorize the shot, followed by actual stillness offered for cooperation.
